attempts.text:
Pranav Ghawat
Pune, Maharashtra, India – pranavghawat22@gmail.com – +91-9552084522

SUMMARY
Quantitative professional with 2+ years of experience building risk-management tools, pricing models and
scenario-analysis frameworks for fixed income and rates products, combined with hands-on trading experience in US
STIR and Treasury futures. Strong grounding in yield-curve relative value, macro-driven rate behavior and
market liquidity dynamics. Engineering graduate from BITS Pilani, skilled in Python, C++, Excel and AI-assisted
development workflows with coursework in derivative pricing.
EXPERIENCE
Quantitative Researcher | Definedge Securities January 2026 – Present
• Options trading tools: Developed a multi-leg options P&L and risk pricer incorporating Delta, Gamma,

Theta and Vega, enabling analysis of spreads, flies and other user-defined strategies.
• Derivatives analytics: Led development of Rzone’s options strategy framework, supporting same-expiry and

calendar spreads/flies and translating relative-value concepts into retail trading tools.
• Quantitative trading tools: Built regression, correlation and pairs-trading scanners in Python/C++,

including cointegration and optimal hedge-ratio analysis; developed a strategy backtesting engine, driving 30–40%
user adoption.

• AI-accelerated development: Used GenAI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) for code generation, debugging and
workflow automation across the build cycle, applying manual review to ensure correctness before deployment.

Market Analyst | Futures First Info Services Pvt Ltd January 2024 – May 2025
• Rates trading: Traded US STIR and Treasury futures across 20+ maturities on CME/CBOT, running

relative-value strategies (spreads, butterflies, condors, ratio trades) to capture curve mispricings, alongside outright
and basis trading of the SOFR–Fed Funds money-market spread, with full ownership of execution, risk and P&L.

• Macro-economic understanding: Built a strong working model of yield-curve shape formation – how Fed
policy path, inflation surprises (CPI/PCE), labor data (NFP) and growth expectations drive curve steepening, flattening
and inversion – used to anticipate curve repositioning ahead of key releases.

• Market microstructure: Traded live through major liquidity-shock events, including the August 2024 yen
carry-trade unwind and the April 2025 tariff-shock volatility, directly observing liquidity air-pockets, spread
widening and order-book fragility under stress.

• Quantitative tooling: Sole analyst in the batch to build a Python pipeline to clean and structure historical
SOFR and Fed Funds futures data for historical curve construction and analysis; also built Excel-based pricing
models and used Bloomberg Terminal/Refinitiv Eikon for real-time monitoring.

• Risk management: Tracked 50+ macro events monthly (FOMC, CPI, NFP, central bank meetings), running
Monte Carlo simulations, stress tests and scenario analysis to model rate-path outcomes and P&L impact across the
curve.

• Execution automation: Built a proprietary ADL-based execution algorithm and automated multi-leg execution
using Trading Technologies’ Autospreader, achieving 70% fills at target price with no payup.

• Performance – Top of batch: Ranked #1 in the 24-member analyst cohort on trading volume, averaging
15,000 round turns/month with 90% directional accuracy on yield-curve trade calls, while scaling book size
responsibly with disciplined VaR limits (up to $80K).

• Recognition: Selected 1 of 4 analysts from the 24-member cohort for a Pre-Placement Offer; recognized by
desk VP, manager and Branch Head for consistent trade quality.

Quantitative Analyst Intern | Futures First Info Services Pvt Ltd July 2023 – December 2023
• Quantitative research: Built and calibrated Vasicek, CIR and Hull-White short-rate models using 60+ months

of US Treasury and SOFR futures data; applied maximum likelihood estimation and numerical optimization.
• Curve construction & backtesting: Constructed yield curves using Nelson-Siegel and cubic-spline interpo-

lation and built a vectorized Python backtesting framework for curve and relative-value strategies, reducing research
runtime by 80%.

EDUCATION
B.E. (Hons), Chemical Engineering 2024
Birla Institute of Technology and Science (BITS), Pilani 8.01/10
Relevant Coursework: Derivatives and Risk Management, Business Analysis and Valuation, Fundamentals of Finance and
Accounting, Numerical Methods
SKILLS
Markets & Trading: Fixed Income, US Rates/STIR, Futures, Options, Yield-Curve Modelling, Relative Value, Risk
Management (VaR)
Analytics: Pricing, P&L Analysis, Monte Carlo/Scenario Analysis, Financial Modelling, Backtesting
Programming & Tools: Python, C++, C, R, MATLAB, Excel, Bloomberg Terminal, Refinitiv Eikon, Trading
Technologies Autospreader
AI Tools: GenAI-assisted development (code generation, debugging, workflow automation)
Languages: English, Marathi, Hindi

mailto:pranavghawat22@gmail.com
